description: This source file is part of the PyTorch codebase, specifically within the 'aten' (ATen tensor library) component. It defines batch rules and helper functions for various tensor operations like embedding, grid sampling, and upsampling, especially when using vmap or batching mechanisms. The implementation includes handling of batch dimensions, batching logic, and registration of these batch rules within the PyTorch operator library.
